source: User-approved home mockup without decorative greeting underline; six subsequent generated screen references.

typography.brand: Small Luma text wordmark until a dedicated transparent wordmark asset is supplied; do not use the square app icon as a wide wordmark.
typography.numbers: tabular numerals; isolate numeric times and ratios in LTR spans

header.home: edge-to-edge desk/window photo with small wordmark upper right, dynamic greeting below, search and notification controls left
header.secondary: shorter photo header with page title; no large greeting
header.timeZone: Asia/Jerusalem; fixed illustrative intervals, configurable; recompute at open/resume and boundaries while visible
header.wordmarkAsset: No standalone wordmark supplied; use an accessible restrained live Luma text wordmark until artwork is provided.

bottomNav.activeStyle: soft blue rounded background, darker filled icon
bottomNav.secondaryRoutes: Keep order consistent; team/questions/counter/reports/work tools through home shortcuts and secondary routes.

buttons.primary: solid muted blue, white text in light mode
buttons.avoid: heavy gradients, excessive shadows, decorative graphics

lists.alignment: RTL, right-side checkbox or icon, left-side overflow or drag handle

sheet.presentation: bottom sheet with dimmed background, swipe dismissal, explicit close, keyboard-safe

implementationNotes: All token values, typeface, dimensions and time boundaries are proposed, not measurements from raster images.
Never render phone bezel, fake iOS clock, or status icons as app content.
Use actual calendar dates, live activity times and persisted records.
Keep work-only content; no projects or personal goals.
No claim that the design has been implemented or accessibility-tested.
Dark palette is proposed; no dark mockup was supplied.
Architecture governs all behavior. Implement all required screens, including those without standalone visual references. No sample records in production.
